name: assessment_llm_support
rubric: Evaluate on these criteria (score 1-5 each): 1. INNOVATION — Novelty and creative approach. 2. FEASIBILITY — Likelihood of successful execution. 3. IMPACT — Potential benefit if successful. 4. CLARITY — Quality of presentation and reasoning.
stimulus: Proposal: Use LLM agents to automate first-line customer support for a mid-sized e-commerce company (500 support tickets/day). The system would handle returns, refunds, and order tracking autonomously, escalating only 20% of cases to humans. Claimed cost reduction: 60%.
